notes.title: FREE Levels Update Coming in 2025!?
notes.content:
[b]We're doing a free levels update soon (in the next few weeks)![/b]

Which is good timing as the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/category/box-pushing]Box-Pushing sale[/url] has resulted in our best Steam sales days by a huge margin!   It's 88% off now! Which is so cheap it makes my eyes water.

Also if you JUST bought the game we'd love a review also!

During development back in 2017 we had a lot of levels that were left on the cutting room floor. Some of these were "too hard" or "too small" or "potential softlocks" or "WTF" or just "too similar to what we already had"  and thus languished in a file for no one ever to see. Even 4 of these were just released as Switch only levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26563430/5fcf6ccbadefbf5018928d7224171c947d9864ca.png[/img]

But now in 2025 we've found a small slither of free time and had fresh eyes look at these levels and looking to re-release them for free. 

[h2]Why Free?[/h2]

There's a few levels which break some of the fundamental rules of the core game (ie the level requires precise timing) but rather that let these sit in a level design purgatory we'll let players enjoy them.  

Without the worry of a curated and focussed level experience, or any more narrative overhead we're free to just release some of the level design chaos. And for free so if anyone complains that's our excuse.

[b]We'll focus on the 2P levels first and the update could be anywhere from 10-50 new levels. [/b]
The number will depend on how many Ash (Studio Head) can convince Pat (Designer) to be "fine" with. I've already started to wear him down!! hahah (Ash is writing this)

These will be added as a [b]new Vault section with a BETA label[/b]. As the levels will not have the same level of external playtesting we did back in 2017.  By giving these away for free YOU are the BETA testers! ~Excellent~

[h2]Why update a 8 year old game?[/h2]
It's also an experiment to see what doing an update like this does to the long tail sales.
Is there interest in a Death Squared 2?  
This is a better way for us to gauge this than starting a totally new project.

notes.title: Moving Out 2 | Pre Orders Now Live
notes.content:
You've seen that we've scheduled our moving date and you've chosen your favourite F.A.R.T, so probably think you are now all set to Move Out now? WRONG! We've one last thing for your checklist...

[h2]PRE-ORDERING MOVING OUT 2![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849904/c5dec40175fdb159950ef1c9a987e5cd7a949a29.jpg[/img]
Moving Out 2 is now available to Pre-Order so you can finally get ready for our August 15th launch date! We've different options available for pre-order available so you can get the right version for you!

[b]Here we are going to unpack what comes in each version available to pre-order
[/b]
[h2]Standard edition[/h2]
Moving Out 2 base game.
 
[h2]Moving Out 1+2 bundle[/h2]
The ultimate Moving Out experience - a copy of both Moving Out 1 & 2 base games in one neat bundle! (This will become available on launch - August 15th)

[h2]Digital Deluxe Edition (PC Exclusive)[/h2] 
There's no better way to move than with the Digital Deluxe Edition of Moving Out 2. 
Includes:[list]
[*] Moving Out 2 base game
[*] The Art & Design of Moving Out 2: A 250+ page digital art book
[*] Jumbo Super Silly Activity Book: A digital kids activity book
[*] Behind the Scenes Commentary: Over 4 hrs of behind-the-scenes commentary on the making of Moving Out 2 from SMG, Brad Gentle the composer and Sub Zero the sound design team
[*] 3D Printable Models: Print your own movers
[*] Soundtrack: 24 Original Tracks composed for the game[/list]
[h2]F.A.R.Tastic Four DLC Pre-order Bonus[/h2]

Every pre-order of either the Standard or Digital Deluxe versions of the game comes with [b]The F.A.R.Tastic Four Pack[/b], a pack of 4 additional movers for Moving Out 2 absolutely free as a little thank you for your eagerness to move out!

notes.title: FREE MAJOR UPDATE
notes.content:
A free major update is here. 

[previewyoutube=LozeyhGlu9E;full][/previewyoutube]

[list]
[*] 15 new levels in the vault (some really crazy ones)
[*] 3 New Game challenge modes (Unlock in the settings, only for those who have finished main game as makes the game MUCH harder)
[*] Rotate Camera (because so many asked for it)
[*] Color Blind Filter (Let us know if we can make it better)
[*] Update to hopefully fix some controller issues (so many variables here)
[/list]

Want to help us out? And it'll cost you nothing?
[list]
[*] Leave a review! Seriously this helps way more than you think. 
[*] Post a screenshot or anything to the community section
[*] Comment below!
[*] Tell a friend about the game
[*] Send us a message about the game. 
[/list]

Reminder: You can play online multiplayer using Parsec. It's free and awesome. https://parsecgaming.com

Or wait for the new Steam BETA which will enable this right from the Steam client!

TODO for us: 
[list]
[*] Re-mappable controls
[*] More controller fixes for the edge cases
[/list]

notes.title: DEMO | Day 1 of The Employee Evaluation routine
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26563430/784ea0f23af0cb12ea4fdbbf8a177ea91ce5856e.jpg[/img]

Not sure about Death Squared? 
The reviews are good, the price is cheap, you've seen the let's plays and they are fun but something just hasn't pushed you over the edge.

Got no one else to play with and worried the single player game will be too hard? There's no online play so you can fly solo in Death Squared and it's like any other puzzle game.

Or have a +1 to play with but worried they'll not appreciate the fine art of being told what to do?

[h1][b]Well dip your toes into our Employee Evaluation DEMO[/b][/h1]

This is the DEMO we have been showing at PAX shows for the last year with a custom fully voiced story VO.

Enjoy! Support us. Tell your friends. Invite them to play! Invite your parents over for some co-op action.

notes.title: Death Squared V1.1.0 Released
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26563430/4a8095ab73bfa7963bb7d0ec5387bf421fca1e23.png[/img]

We are happy to release Death Squared V1.1.0. This is our largest update to the game since launch and includes some long requested features and adjustments.

This update includes:
[list]
[*]Translations and Subtitles: The game now supports multiple languages in the UI and new in-game subtitles in the following languages:
[list]
[*]English
[*]Spanish
[*]German
[*]French
[*]Portuguese
[*]Russian
[*]Chinese (Simplified)
[*]Chinese (Traditional)
[*]Japanese
[*]Korean
[/list]
[*]Enable subtitles and change language from the settings menu.
[*]It is now possible to play Party Mode on a keyboard. Hold down the left and right shift keys to toggle between Red/Yellow and Blue/Green bots respectively.
[*]Fixed various bugs that can occur when combining keyboard and controllers to play.
[*]Fixed a bug that was occurring for some players that caused goal circles to repeatedly turn on and off.
[*]Level fixes and balancing.
[*]Support for more controller types.
[*]Various input system fixes.
